items.t: Burning clutch smell from dual-clutch automatic
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,712–$2,071 for a 500L clutch. One dual-clutch owner was quoted just under $4,000 at a dealer.
If the clutches are worn, see the clutch replacement cost.

items.t: Dual-clutch automatic shifts harshly or ignores shift requests
items.job: Reflash transmission, body and cluster computers

items.t: Shifter may not select a gear (recall)
items.job: Replace shifter module or update shifter software

items.t: Engine may stay at idle power when you press the gas (recall)
Driver knee airbag may not deploy properly (recall)
Passenger front airbag may not deploy properly (recall)
Dead battery after sitting a few days
items.job: Battery drain test; replace 12-volt battery; update software

items.t: Engine won't crank and key stuck in ignition
items.job: Diagnose no-start; test battery and ignition switch

items.t: Engine oil leaks or low oil between changes
items.job: Find leak with dye; replace gasket or seal
items.note: Cost depends on where the leak is.

items.t: Burnt valves or cylinder head damage on high-mileage engines
items.job: Repair or replace cylinder head and valves
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $6,200 for this repair.

items.t: Check engine light fixed by engine computer update
A/C blows warm or compressor fails
items.job: Recharge A/C, or replace A/C compressor
items.note: A recharge costs far less than a compressor.

items.t: Uconnect radio resets, Bluetooth drops or screen glitches
Oil pressure light flashes with oil change message
